name: the cuban mish was too scared to get
bread: pressed cuban bread, buttered on the outside
mood_when_made: beaten but happy. eight chuds deep. no blanket. making the sandwich he should've gotten.
verdict: the bread cracked when i bit it. mustard hit first, then the pickles cut through the pork. warm all the way through. better than any bagel on earth. he missed out.
